description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Paginator' for handling list pagination within the OFBiz framework, including methods for calculating page sizes, indices, and preparing paginated views.

classes.name: Paginator
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for list pagination, index calculations, and pager preparation within the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: getActualPageSize
methods.description: Returns the actual page size from the context, defaulting to the difference between high and low indices if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getHighIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the high index from the context, defaulting to 0 if not set.

methods.name: getListLimits
methods.description: Calculates and sets list pagination limits (list size, view index, view size, low and high indices) based on the model form, context, and entry list.

methods.name: getListSize
methods.description: Retrieves the list size from the context, defaulting to 0.

methods.name: getLowIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the low index from the context, defaulting to 0.

methods.name: getViewIndex
methods.description: Determines the current view index based on the model form and context, handling different data types and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Determines the current view size based on the model form and context, with fallback to default properties.

methods.name: preparePager
methods.description: Prepares pagination by setting list limits, counting items, and resetting iterators, based on the model form and context.

methods.name: safeNext
methods.description: Safely advances an iterator, returning null if no more elements are available.

methods.name: getViewIndex (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves the view index from the context with a default value.

methods.name: getViewIndex (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves the view index from the context with a specified default value.

methods.name: getViewSize (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves the view size from the context, with a default fallback.
